lessons.title: Nouns
lessons.description: Learn about words that name people, places, and things.

lessons.title: Verbs
lessons.description: Discover action words — run, jump, think, and more.

lessons.title: Adjectives
lessons.description: Add describing words to make sentences more colorful.

lessons.title: Adverbs
lessons.description: Learn words that tell how, when, or where something happens.

lessons.title: Finding the Main Idea
lessons.description: Figure out what a story or passage is mostly about.

lessons.title: Story Characters
lessons.description: Get to know who the characters are and what they do.

lessons.title: Setting
lessons.description: Learn to identify where and when a story takes place.

lessons.title: Beginning, Middle, End
lessons.description: Every story has three parts — find them!

lessons.title: What Makes a Sentence?
lessons.description: Every sentence needs a subject and a verb.

lessons.title: Statements
lessons.description: Write sentences that tell something and end with a period.

lessons.title: Questions
lessons.description: Write sentences that ask something and end with a question mark.

lessons.title: Exclamations
lessons.description: Write exciting sentences that end with an exclamation point!

lessons.title: Short Vowel Words
lessons.description: Practice words like cat, bed, pig, hot, and bug.

lessons.title: Long Vowel Words
lessons.description: Learn words with silent e — like cake, bike, and home.

lessons.title: Blends and Digraphs
lessons.description: Master sounds like bl, tr, sh, ch, and th.

lessons.title: Compound Words
lessons.description: Put two words together — sun + flower = sunflower!
